sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:12

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:12:1
items.html: A phase that connects with the Taamim of MA, etc.: For the ten Sefirot of Nekudim came out in the five Partzufim Galgalta, AB, SAG, MA and BON, as above in part 7. Therefore there are within them too Taamim, Nekudot, Tagin and letters, each phase of which connects with the phase that corresponds to it in the Taamim, Nekudot, Tagin and letters of the new MA, except that there are in them certain differences, which will be explained further along.
